description: We are Team Nexorion, a group of passionate computer science students building an immersive, gamified web app for the "Build A Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer" challenge. We specialize in front-end development, interactive logic, and problem-solving. We are looking for creative teammates with a knack for UI/UX design, gamification mechanics, or educational content creation. Join us if you want to build a fun, out-of-this-world learning experience for future astronauts!
